# Rationalism Has Risen Against Schiller and Dewey[^1]

Messrs. Schiller's and Dewey's theories have suffered a hailstorm of contempt and ridicule. All rationalism has risen against them. A hailstorm of contempt and ridicule throws so much sidelight upon that rationalistic temper to which I, William James, have opposed the temper of pragmatism.
